svg.title: Matriz — Project dashboard, low-fidelity wireframe (proposal pending MVP approval, OQ-016)
svg.desc: Proposed MVP screen showing one project's name and state, progress, tasks, and members as seen by the Project Owner of an Active project, plus four variants: zero tasks, an empty name or title, a Completed project, and a Project Participant's view. Numbered markers refer to the annotations on the right. All wording and sample data are placeholders because the user-facing language is open (OQ-013). Text alternative and traceability: project-dashboard.md.
svg.text: PROPOSAL — PENDING MVP APPROVAL (OQ-016) · NOT AN APPROVED DESIGN · NOT AN IMPLEMENTATION
Matriz v0.1 · Low-fidelity wireframe of one screen: Project dashboard (a single project) · Text alternative, traceability and open questions: docs/ui/project-dashboard.md
All UI wording and sample data are placeholders: the user-facing language is open (OQ-013; Assumption A-013).

text.tspan: · Scenario: the Project Owner viewing an Active project (sample data from US-004 and US-006)

svg.text: Unavailable while tasks are To do or In progress
Has assigned tasks: cannot be removed

text.tspan: — other states of the same screen, not separate screens

svg.text: A · Project with zero tasks: progress (EX-005; A-006)
B · Empty name or title (EX-002, EX-010, EX-011; A-003, A-004)
No task is created (EX-002). The same pattern applies when renaming
a project (EX-010) or a task (EX-011): the name or title stays unchanged.
C · Completed project: read-only (A-011; EX-008, EX-009)
D · Seen by Ana, a Project Participant (US-004, US-005, EX-004)
No dashed (Project Owner) controls; Ana can change only her own task's state.
Task area only; participants' view of members is open (OQ-002, OQ-011).
Dashed outline: available only to the Project Owner (A-001)
Grey text: unavailable now; its reason is shown beside it
Placeholder; names and titles are sample data
Note n below · A-xxx: unvalidated assumption (constraints.md)
Opens the person's own project list (FR-001, US-007), not drawn.
Only identified members can open this screen (EX-003, EX-012; A-002, A-014).
State: Active or Completed (A-003). Rename: Project Owner, Active
project, nonempty name (FR-003, US-008, EX-009, EX-010; A-011).
Project Owner only (FR-007, US-010). Unavailable, with its reason,
while any task is To do or In progress (EX-006; A-003, A-007, A-011).
Task counts by state and % Done = Done / all tasks × 100 (FR-012,
US-006; A-006). Zero tasks: variant A. Rounding is open (OQ-005).
Title, state, and assignee or Unassigned (FR-006, US-004; A-002, A-004).
Row order is illustrative only: no ordering is specified.
Project Owner only. Title only: the task starts To do, unassigned
(FR-008, US-003; A-004, A-010). Empty title: variant B (EX-002).
To do, In progress or Done in any order; Done can be reopened
(FR-011, US-005; A-001, A-005). Project Owner: any task (EX-013). Project
Participant: only tasks assigned to them (EX-004; variant D).
Project Owner only, on unassigned tasks: one member of this project
(FR-010, US-012; A-004). No reassign or unassign control (OQ-007).
Project Owner only; nonempty title (FR-009, US-011, EX-011; A-004).
Each member and their role (FR-002, FR-004, FR-005; US-001, US-002,
US-009; A-001). The creator is shown as Project Owner and member (A-008).
How people are named on screen is open (OQ-011, OQ-018).
Project Owner only; a non-owner member without assigned tasks
(FR-005, US-009; A-002, A-009). Ana has tasks: unavailable, reason shown
(EX-007). No control for the Project Owner's membership (OQ-008).
Project Owner only; grants access to this project (FR-004, US-002;
A-002). Finding and identifying the person is open (OQ-001, OQ-018).
The project list and Create project (FR-001, FR-002, US-001, US-007).
No reassign or unassign (OQ-007), reopen project (OQ-006), or change
of Project Owner (OQ-008): unspecified, so not drawn.
Nothing from 'Outside the initial scope' in requirements.md.
Hiding or disabling a control does not replace the checks of NFR-002
(OQ-019); every change is still subject to them.

Generated locally as SVG by the AI agent; no wireframing tool was used. The frame implies no device: devices and contexts of use are open (OQ-021), and how the interface is delivered is undecided (architecture.md).
